title: Piano in the district, banjos and Wilbur Sweatman
summary: Braud says piano was used only in the district and banjos arrived about 1917, and starts to mention Wilbur Sweatman.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Was he still in the New Orleans band?
Oh yeah, he had a gig band around here.
Great guy. Still looked well too.
Did they ever use banjos when you were down here much?

No, guitar. Only after I left here, when banjos got popular, I think around 1917 or 18, because all the bands up north were using banjos. Did they use tubas in the band? And I had a friend of mine by the name of Wilbur Sweatman, I guess you heard that. He wrote the Down Home Rag. Where...
